result.summary: The page is mostly polished, but a few elements appear clipped or obscured, especially near the right edge and behind the fixed bottom navigation.

issues.description: The bottom navigation bar overlaps the feed content. The second restaurant card in the “Popular right now” section is partially hidden behind the fixed tab bar, making the card feel cut off.
issues.suggestion: Add sufficient bottom padding or safe-area spacing to the scrollable content so cards can scroll fully above the bottom navigation.

issues.description: The horizontal restaurant carousel under “Fastest near you” is cut off on the right edge. The third card and its restaurant name are only partially visible, which can look visually broken if not intended as a scroll hint.
issues.suggestion: Use clearer carousel spacing, snapping, or edge padding so partially visible cards look intentional, or ensure cards fit cleanly within the viewport.

issues.description: The category chip row has a partially visible item at the far right with no clear label, which may look like an accidental clipping issue.
issues.suggestion: Add right-side padding, improve horizontal scroll affordance, or adjust chip widths so the clipped item appears intentionally scrollable.
